Elaine (People Ops): Quick q — we have a small group asking about PTO encashment after holiday blackout. Our standard says carryover preferred, but is there pathway for payout if team couldn't take time due to mandatory coverage?
Samuel Jacobs: Yep, need this. Three folks covered on-call for holiday window and couldn't use PTO. Can we make an exception to payout instead of forcing carryover?
Elaine (People Ops): Short answer: encashments are "exception-only". Policy allows carryover up to 40h; payouts require director approval + payroll cutoff compliance. Need manager attestation explaining why time couldn't be used. See form: https://redwood.example.com/hr/pto-encashment-form :paperclip: 
Maria - Payroll: FYI payroll deadline for Dec payouts is `2025-12-05` (submit by EOD 2025-12-03 to be safe). Anything after that moves to next cycle. Payouts are taxed as regular wages and coded as PTO payout.
Samuel Jacobs: Got it. Also one of the team is part-time and started Sept 15 — how do we calculate accrual/prorate for payout if approved?
Elaine (People Ops): For mid-year joins: accrual = (days employed / 365) * annual allotment, rounded to nearest hour. Part-time prorate uses FTE fraction. We can run numbers if you paste names + start dates.
Diego K.: @Samuel can you cc me? I was on parental leave for Nov and missed the PTO window. Any LOA exceptions?
Elaine (People Ops): LOA/leave exceptions considered case-by-case. We generally allow a carryover or make-up accrual for protected leaves. Please file a people-ops ticket with leave dates and manager note.
HR Bot: Reminder — Winter blackout for company-wide PTO: `2025-12-20` to `2026-01-03`. All PTO requests during blackout require manager + People Ops approval. Submit before Nov 20 to avoid edge cases.
Samuel Jacobs: Thanks all. I'll collect manager attestations and submit the PTO encashment form + list of start dates by Nov 30. @Maria i'll aim for Dec 3 cutoff. 
Maria - Payroll: Great — ping me once form is in and we'll slot it. :white_check_mark:
Elaine (People Ops): Thanks team. If anyone else has similar cases (e.g., coverage obligation, critical launches), DM me so we can batch approvals and keep payroll timing tidy. :calendar:
